theorems.name: Submission.gte_weight_null_finite
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∀ K : Set (Amb n ℓ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → V.weight K < ⊤) ∧ V.weight (V.support)ᶜ = 0 ∧ ∀ Z : Set (Amb n ℓ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) Z = 0 → V.weight Z = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
